purpose: Discover real current destinations where an approved relevance route may legitimately belong, without creating or publishing content.
input_rule: Only ROUTE entries from an approved relevance register are eligible.
rules: destination must currently exist and be externally verifiable
audience fit must be evidenced, not guessed
discovery does not imply permission to publish
record access or participation constraints where known
prefer specific legitimate destinations over generic platform names
do not create variants or publish at this stage
